text:
### Observed differences

- In the later window, activity A01 appears for the first time: it was absent from all 200 earlier traces and occurs exactly once in each of the 200 later traces, late in the case at roughly 76% of the event position on average [OCC001, POS001].
- The hand-over into A08 was rerouted through A01: earlier, about 60 in 100 of A04's outgoing transitions went directly to A08 and about 69 in 100 of A09's; in the later window, A04 sends about 88 in 100 and A09 about 91 in 100 of its outgoing transitions to A01, with almost none going straight to A08 [DIR004, DIR008].
- A01's outgoing transitions lead mainly to A08 (about 73 in 100), and less often to A07 (about 17) or A06 (about 11) [DIR001].
- The A01–A08 pair changed from never occurring together (A08 alone in 100 in 100 earlier traces) to always occurring together with A01 first (100 in 100 later traces) [REL004].
- Step distances grew by about one step, consistent with an activity inserted in between: A04→A08 moved from lag 1 in about 60 in 100 observed cases (lag 2 in the rest) to lags 2–3, A09→A08 from lag 1 (about 69 in 100) to lags 2–3, and A04/A09→A06/A07 from lag 1 in all observed cases to mostly lag 2; this last group rests on only about 10–35 observations per pair [LAG003, LAG012, LAG001, LAG002, LAG010, LAG011].
- A06 and A07 now also pass control to A01 in about 10 in 100 of their outgoing transitions, and their distances to A08 lengthened (A06→A08 shifted from lags 1–3 towards 3–5; A07→A08 towards 4–5) [DIR006, DIR007, LAG005, LAG008].
- A04, A06, A07 and A09 appear at earlier event positions in the later window (for example A04's mean position fell from about 0.65 to about 0.50 and A09's from about 0.74 to about 0.62); because positions are relative to case length, this is consistent with one extra event per case rather than with these activities being moved [POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005].
- The choice between the alternatives A06 and A07 shifted: A06 was executed in about 55 in 100 cases earlier and about 47 in 100 later, A07 rose from about 45 to about 54 in 100, and the two never occur in the same trace in either window [REL010, OCC004, OCC005].

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that a new activity, A01, was inserted into the process and is executed once per case between the branch activities A04/A09 and A08: earlier, A04 and A09 handed over directly to A08 (about 60 and 69 in 100 of their outgoing transitions), whereas in the later window they hand over to A01 (about 88 and 91 in 100), which in turn leads mainly to A08 (about 73 in 100) [OCC001, DIR001, DIR004, DIR008, REL004].

The signs are direct and consistent across indicator families: A01 goes from 0 of 200 to 200 of 200 traces, A01 and A08 go from never co-occurring to co-occurring in every trace with A01 first, the successor profiles of A04 and A09 flip from A08 to A01, and the step distances from A04/A09 to A08 and to A06/A07 grow by about one step, with A06 and A07 also feeding into A01 in a minority of transitions [OCC001, REL004, DIR004, DIR008, LAG003, LAG012, LAG005, LAG008, DIR006, DIR007].

Limitation: the evidence cannot determine whether A06's and A07's new links to A01 belong to the same insertion or reflect an additional rewiring of the segment around A08, and the competing explanation of a broader restructuring of that segment beyond the A04/A09→A01→A08 backbone cannot be ruled out [DIR006, DIR007, LAG001, LAG002, LAG010, LAG011].

Other differences: the frequency of the existing choice between the alternatives A06 and A07 shifted by about 8 in 100 cases towards A07 (both remain observed in about half of the traces in both windows), and A03's outgoing mix shifted slightly away from A06 towards A04 and A05; both differences are small enough that sampling variation between the two windows remains a plausible explanation [REL010, OCC004, OCC005, DIR003].
